title: Frontend Engineer
description: Build and maintain the interfaces our clients' customers use every day. You'll work closely with design and backend engineering on real product features, not just component libraries.
requirements: 2+ years with React or a similar framework. Comfortable with accessibility basics and responsive layout. Bonus: experience with design systems.

title: Backend Engineer
description: Design and build APIs that other engineers (and sometimes clients directly) depend on. You'll own things end to end, from schema design to deployment.
requirements: Experience with Node.js or a comparable backend language. Understanding of REST API design and basic database modeling. Bonus: experience with authentication systems.

title: Product Designer
description: Partner directly with clients and engineers to turn rough problems into shipped, usable products.
requirements: A portfolio showing real shipped work, not just concepts. Comfort presenting design decisions to non-designers.
